snippet.title: Mega Drive Longplay [008] Castlevania: Bloodlines
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: xRavenXP

Castlevania: Bloodlines is the only Castlevania video game series which was released for Mega Drive/Genesis. It was developed and published by Konami and was first released to North America on June 1, 1994. Its title is the Japanese version of Vampire Killer and its title in the European version is Castlevania: the New Generation. Not long after the death of Dracula, a witch practicing black magic accidentally resurrected Elizabeth Bartley, a countess known as "Dracula's niece" (obviously based on Elizabeth Bathory), who decided to bring his uncle to life. For this, she started World War sacrificed so many souls were available for his evil purpose. John Morris, using the whip "Vampire Killer", and his friend Eric Lecarde, using the "Alcarde Spear", knew it and run to stop Bartley and Dracula again. Played in expert mode (unlocked after ending game one time or with "Konami Code" in title screen: up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B and A), with the two characters and with true endings.
